assumptions: Genus = first word of current_name in taxonomy.csv (WoRMS 2025-10), so renamed species are assigned to their current genus.
Bray-Curtis on raw counts, unweighted mean over all 253 sample pairs; all 23 samples kept.
issues: Sample N05 has very low counts (low yield per lab log); kept since raw counts were requested, but it inflates dissimilarities.
Several 1987 names are outdated (e.g. Globigerina pachyderma, G. quinqueloba, Globigerinoides sacculifer) and were remapped, changing genus composition.
summary: Mapped recorded names to current genera, summed counts, computed pairwise Bray-Curtis on raw counts and averaged.
